intro: Around 200 hours, in one playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. The only missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude: meditate at Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1, before the chapter ends.

stages.text: Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. The story trophies unlock in order as you play. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot before Chapter 1 ends — it is the list's only missable trophy.
stages.tip: Manual save at the start of every chapter. No mission replay.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.text: Strangers appear with a marker on the map. Follow five strands to their final missions and finish eight strands in total, plus Bret's hunt.
stages.tip: Take a stranger's missions whenever you see the marker — strands unlock as you explore.
stages.title: Strangers and side strands

stages.text: The shooting range, stunts, races, fishing, the arcade and the challenges. Gold all 42 range challenges, win 20 races and 14 drone races, and finish 50 challenges.
stages.tip: Retries are free on range challenges and drone races — use them.
stages.title: Activities and combat

stages.text: The partner trophies, the odd ones and the quiet moments: a 4-star escape with your partner, three shops in a row, a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a bowling game, a showroom smash and the strange events.
stages.tip: Do the partner trophies while a partner is available — availability changes with the story.
stages.title: Leonida life

stages.text: Card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles, the 52 areas of Leonida, garage properties and the Scooter Bros app — plus the money: launder $250,000 in Marked Bills and spend $100,000 in shops.
stages.tip: Register every new vehicle to Scooter Bros as you find it, and launder Marked Bills as you rob.
stages.title: Collectibles and the economy

stages.text: Finish the in-game 100% checklist — story, strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — for A Long Road. The platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 is earned.
stages.tip: The in-game checklist is the source of truth for 100%.
stages.title: 100% and the platinum

title: Road to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
